overview: Visual Product Similarity Search addresses staff search multiple approved sources manually and struggle to preserve permissions and version context in retail and e-commerce operations. The first proof of value uses product images, attributes and stock flags. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is image-search click-to-product rate, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: product images, attributes and stock flags; define image-search click-to-product rate and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from Head of E-commerce / Merchandising Director.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including golden question set with prompt-injection and authorization tests.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
